task_envelope.task_description: Eight pose-specific fingertip force-region requirements covering pinch, tripod, extended reach, deep flexion and abduction

other_conditions: Source physical force measurement validated one pose only

finger, remote actuators, electronics, cabling, power and mounts

evidence.locator: arXiv:2611.05302; source sections/tables on tendon routing, eight-pose library, task force coverage, actuator selection and prototype force validation
evidence.notes: Preprint. Model predictions, source-reported physical measurement and loss-aware model rescoring are separately classified in metric observations.

claim_ceiling: This record transcribes source-reported PACT metrics and one-pose physical force validation. It does not reproduce the prototype, validate the full eight-pose physical force coverage, establish whole-hand grasp stability, or qualify any Luminous hardware.
